title: Factor-two hardness of Vertex Cover
exact_target: For each fixed $\varepsilon >0$, is approximating the minimum vertex cover of a finite simple unweighted graph within $2-\varepsilon $ NP-hard under deterministic polynomial-time reductions? No bounded-degree or counting-logic indistinguishability promise is imposed.
